title: Busy self-employed contractor brushes off the call
scenario: Self-employed electrician interested in refinancing to consolidate debt keeps saying he is too busy. Rep tries discovery and settles for a callback.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi, is this Rusty? This is Ingrid with Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah. Who?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ingrid, with Copperleaf Home Loans. You'd asked about a refinance to pay down some debt?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Oh, right, right. Look, I'm on a job site. It's been a crazy busy few weeks.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Understood, I'll be quick. Are you still thinking about consolidating that debt?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, I got a truck loan and some cards that are killing me.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Got it. And you're self-employed, is that right?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yep. Own my own electrical outfit, eight years now.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Nice. Do you file a Schedule C or do you run it through an S-corp?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: S-corp, I think. My accountant does all that.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's helpful. We'd probably want your last two years of returns at some point.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, yeah. Like I said, it's nuts out here right now.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Totally get it. When's a better time to go through it properly?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I don't know, maybe after five some day.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: How about Thursday at five-thirty?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Thursday's fine.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Great. I'll call you then. Should I use this same number?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yep, this number.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Perfect. Be safe up there, Rusty.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Will do. Later.
